title: The 5 levels of making money: Sam Parr on $10K to $100M and what changes at each stage
summary: Sam Parr walks through the stages from $10K to $100M. Early on it's selling a service, asking for money and cold emailing. At the middle stages you need distribution, hiring and systems. Past $10M it's time and patience. He also covers copywriting, peers, intentional goals and integrity.

principles.text: The easiest first $10K is a service: do it free for 2-3 companies, get a testimonial, then charge. Ask for the money and price higher than you think.
principles.quote: it would probably be finding two or three companies that need a service, doing it to them for free, asking for a testimonial, and getting proof, and then going and charging for that service.

principles.text: Copywriting is the most valuable skill at any stage because it's just sales: getting what's in your head into someone else's and moving them to act.
principles.quote: copywriting is the act of figuring out how to get what's in my brain into your brain and figuring out how to get you to do what I want you to do.

principles.text: Cold outreach is a numbers game. Follow up relentlessly (he emailed one speaker 52 times) and use attention, interest, desire, action.
principles.quote: I emailed him 52 times. And on the 52nd one, he was like, "Yeah, sure."

principles.text: Past roughly $100K a month you need real distribution (audience, ads, cold email or calls, conferences). Reaching 3-5M is straightforward, past that you need teams, systems and leadership.
principles.quote: getting to like 3, four, 5 million is a pretty straightforward path. Getting past five, six, seven million, that requires uh teams and systems and leadership and that is challenging.

principles.text: Hiring is the highest leverage for a founder. Hire people strong where you're weak, and keep doing sales and marketing yourself until about $5M.
principles.quote: the highest form of leverage for an entrepreneur is hiring.

principles.text: Most businesses can reach $10M+ if you stay patient and build systems. The common failure is impatience, quitting something that's working.
principles.quote: I will say every single business or service or product can get to 10 million in revenue.
